name: Za Warudo
primary: Dio's stand power from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. Time stops within 16 blocks of you for 5 s. Every mob there that is not your ally freezes in place, even mid-air, and arrows and fireballs hang still. You move freely and can strike the frozen. When time resumes, projectiles fly on and every frozen mob is stunned for 1 s more.
self_description: Works the same: time stops around you.
